metadata.title: Webinars
metadata.description: Documentation and examples for the OpenStax Webinar components.

content.value:
Overview

Three blocks render OpenStax webinars from the CMS feed: Upcoming Webinars (a grid of the soonest events), Webinar Library (past webinars, filterable by subject, with collections shown as tags), and Featured Webinar (one webinar highlighted by id). All ship in @openstax/flex-page-os-blocks and load their data server-side. Upcoming vs. past is decided when the page is built, so rebuild to refresh.

Upcoming Webinars

The next few webinars, soonest first. Set how many to show, an optional subject, and a description word limit.

Config options

  • count — how many upcoming webinars to show (default 3).
  • subject — optional; show only webinars tagged with this subject, e.g. Science.
  • description_words — trim each description to at most this many words.
  • per_page — show this many at a time with Previous/Next controls.
  • cta_text — override the register-link label on every card.

Used here: {"count": 3, "description_words": 25, "cta_text": "Register now"}

Featured Webinar

A single webinar highlighted by its id.

Config options

  • webinar_id — required; the id of the webinar to feature, from the feed.
  • eyebrow — small label shown above the webinar (default "Featured webinar").

Used here: {"webinar_id": 445}

Webinar Library

All webinars in one block, filterable by subject; each card shows its collections as tags. Upcoming webinars get a Register link and past ones get a Watch recording link. This example trims descriptions and paginates 6 per page.

Config options

  • show — which webinars to list: past (default), upcoming, or all.
  • default_subject — optional; pre-select this subject in the filter (readers can change it).
  • count — maximum webinars to show after filtering (blank shows all).
  • description_words — trim each description to at most this many words.
  • per_page — show this many at a time with Previous/Next controls.
  • future_cta_text — link label on upcoming webinars, e.g. Register now.
  • past_cta_text — link label on past webinars, e.g. Watch recording.

Used here: {"show": "all", "description_words": 20, "per_page": 6, "future_cta_text": "Register now", "past_cta_text": "Watch recording"}
